changes.text: Daily journal: a page per day for how the day went, something you're grateful for, and a word for how it felt. Disabled by default. Turn it on per profile under Settings > Journal.
Import from Obsidian: upload a zip of your daily notes folder to bring existing entries across. A day that already has an entry is never overwritten.
Countdowns now say 'passed' instead of 'overdue' when the date has passed.
Text flashing in an unstyled font for a moment on first load.
